fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate shows the gate run in the run worktree when unstable, skipped when stable, skipped with no gate set, and a failing gate failing the step with its output; go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow passes with the gate step before each push step of ship-change.toml and its on.fail to a fixer; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ship-local-gate passes, showing in its own repo rhiza daemon settings --json listing rhiza.ship.localGate as a project setting with an empty default (source default), and rhiza daemon set rhiza.ship.localGate 'make check' then listing it with value make check from git config
fields.statement: While CI is unstable, the built-in ship-change workflow runs the project's local gate command (rhiza.ship.localGate; make check for Rhiza itself) in the run's worktree before every push and pushes only when it exits 0, sending a failing gate to a fixer like a red CI; while CI is stable, or with no gate set, the step passes at once and the run keeps its scoped tests
